description: This file defines utility classes, data structures, and functions for managing resources in Apache Spark, including resource identification, requests, requirements, allocation, and discovery mechanisms. It handles resource configuration parsing, validation, and resource discovery plugin integration.

classes.name: ResourceID
classes.description: Represents a unique identifier for a resource component (driver, executor, task) with methods for configuration keys.

classes.name: ResourceRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a resource request including resource ID, amount, optional discovery script, and vendor.

classes.name: ResourceRequirement
classes.description: Defines resource requirements for a component, including resource name, amount, and subdivision parts.

classes.name: ResourceAllocation
classes.description: Represents allocated resource addresses for a resource, with conversion to ResourceInformation.

methods.name: parseResourceRequest
methods.description: Parses resource request configuration from SparkConf for a given ResourceID.

methods.name: listResourceIds
methods.description: Lists ResourceID objects for a component based on SparkConf configuration.

methods.name: parseAllResourceRequests
methods.description: Parses all resource requests for a component from SparkConf.

methods.name: calculateAmountAndPartsForFraction
methods.description: Calculates integer amount and parts for fractional resource amounts.

methods.name: addTaskResourceRequests
methods.description: Adds task resource requests from SparkConf to a TaskResourceRequests object.

methods.name: parseResourceRequirements
methods.description: Parses resource requirements for a component, supporting fractional resources for tasks.

methods.name: executorResourceRequestToRequirement
methods.description: Converts executor resource requests to resource requirements.

methods.name: resourcesMeetRequirements
methods.description: Checks if available resources meet specified requirements.

methods.name: withResourcesJson
methods.description: Reads and extracts resource info from a JSON file.

methods.name: parseAllocatedFromJsonFile
methods.description: Parses resource allocations from a JSON file.

methods.name: parseAllocated
methods.description: Parses resource allocations from a file or configuration for a specific component.

methods.name: parseAllocatedOrDiscoverResources
methods.description: Gets resource allocations from file or discovers them if not specified.

methods.name: assertResourceAllocationMeetsRequest
methods.description: Validates that a resource allocation meets a request.

methods.name: assertAllResourceAllocationsMeetRequests
methods.description: Validates multiple resource allocations against their requests.

methods.name: assertAllResourceAllocationsMatchResourceProfile
methods.description: Ensures resource allocations match the resource profile requirements.

methods.name: getOrDiscoverAllResources
methods.description: Retrieves or discovers all resources for a component based on configuration and resource file.

methods.name: getOrDiscoverAllResourcesForResourceProfile
methods.description: Retrieves or discovers resources based on ResourceProfile and configuration.

methods.name: logResourceInfo
methods.description: Logs information about resources allocated to a component.

methods.name: discoverResource
methods.description: Discovers resource information using configured plugins.

methods.name: validateTaskCpusLargeEnough
methods.description: Validates that executor cores are sufficient for task CPU requirements.

methods.name: warnOnWastedResources
methods.description: Logs warnings if resource configuration may lead to resource wastage.

methods.name: emptyStringToOptional
methods.description: Converts an empty string to an empty Optional, otherwise wraps the string.
